name: Token Mapping
instruction: Map every source value to a Paper design token before building. Prefer Paper tokens that use the project's {prefix}; computed styles arrive as resolved values (rgb(), px), so match them by value against both Paper's token set and {token_files}.

mapping_order.exception: opacity-modified colors with no token may use literals

tailwind_resolution.when: source uses utility classes (text-navy-700, bg-slate-50, rounded-2xl)
steps: Resolve each class to its computed CSS value
Map to the closest Paper token
